_doc: pla-01 exception strip (director 2026-11-20): short glossary copy that supersedes the tt-01/tt-02/trp-01 fixtures, and the Grimoire lines that now hold the detail cut from tooltips. Read by tests/test_short_card_tooltips.py, tests/short_card_tooltips_test.gd, tests/text_budget_test.py and tests/test_card_panel_text.py; the historical fixtures stay untouched.

glossary.traps: Trigger when entered or attacked, hitting the unit on them and spreading their element around them.
glossary.summon_minions: Calls the shown enemy into the fight.
glossary.lightning_storm: On its beat, lightning strikes every Electrified tile.
glossary.guard_ally: Gives Block to the shown allies.
glossary.all_enemies: Hits every visible enemy that meets the shown condition.
glossary.reflect: Attacks from a non-adjacent tile bounce back to the attacker.
glossary.skill_measured_breath: At the end of your turn, bank 1 unused @icon(card_play) for your next turn.
glossary.skill_confluence: Once per combat, @icon(surface_relocate) 1 ground tile within @icon(range) 4.

keyword:marked: A buried Burrow Grub can't be moved, but attacks that hit an area still hit it.
If a Burrow Grub's mark is blocked, it erupts on the nearest free tile.
keyword:burst: Kindle adds to its Burst damage, up to 4 more.
keyword:blink: A Gloam Stalker's Fade lands next to you when the tile behind you is blocked.
combat:boss_eclipse: Braziers still relight, and Snuff's Shades still leave, even when the enemy's turn is skipped.

card_panel_text.meteorfall: At your next turn, the marked tiles take the damage and turn to Fire.
card_panel_text.unchanged_creates_one_illusion_on_each_e: Creates one illusion on each empty tile next to you.
card_panel_text.illusion_nearby: Also hits each other enemy next to one of your illusions.
